request.purpose: Before we place temporary workers we want to know which age groups carry this disease, so we can offer those groups only short-term contracts.
request.question: What is the prevalence of obesity among adults, by region and age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Obesity = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E66.
Prevalence = adults with obesity / all adults in the group × 100, one decimal.
Report per region and age band: adults, adults with obesity and the prevalence.
